text: Chilean road lines are either **all white**, or **all yellow**:
- All white road lines are most common. Within the Americas, they are a good clue for Chile, though not completely unique.
- All yellow road lines are seen in National Parks or areas of high snowfall. Within the Americas, these all yellow road lines are essentially unique to Chile.
You will almost **never** see a combination of the two colours, apart from a few rare exceptions.
NOTE: It is important to note that Argentina has a decent amount of roads with all white road lines.
text_zh: 智利的道路標線**全部為白色**，或是**全部為黃色**：
- 全白道路標線最為常見。在美洲大陸內，它們是智利很好的線索，雖然並非完全獨有。
- 全黃道路標線見於國家公園或降雪量大的地區。在美洲大陸內，這些全黃道路標線基本上是智利特有的。
除了少數罕見例外，你幾乎**絕不會**看到這兩種顏色的組合。
注意：必須注意的是，阿根廷有相當數量的道路擁有全白道路標線。

text: Chile has a solid **white** Google Car with no antenna in **Generation 3**. There are two variants:
- [A plain white car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1nNGSJYhdk9Th3c9A) (left).
- [A white car with a visible black section](https://goo.gl/maps/sk6weUxKpaC7pAvz7) (right). This car is unique to Chile.
A blue Google Car can be seen in Generation 4.
NOTE: In Generation 3, a plain white Google Car with no antenna can also be seen in Peru and Bolivia.
text_zh: 智利有一台無天線的純**白色** Google 車，屬於**第三代相機**。有兩種款式：
- [一台素色白車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1nNGSJYhdk9Th3c9A)（左）。
- [一台帶有明顯黑色部分的白車](https://goo.gl/maps/sk6weUxKpaC7pAvz7)（右）。這台車是智利特有的。
第四代相機可以看到藍色 Google 車。
注意：在第三代相機中，秘魯和玻利維亞也能看到無天線的純白色 Google 車。

text: Chile uses square concrete poles with an **indent** on both sides. They are somewhat similar to Brazilian poles, however have fewer horizontal supports in the indent. The upper part typically has small pinholes.
Wooden poles are also fairly common.
text_zh: 智利使用兩側皆有**凹槽**的正方形混凝土電線桿。它們與巴西的電線桿有些相似，但在凹槽中的水平支撐較少。上部通常有小針孔。
木造電線桿也相當常見。

text: Regular vehicles have **white** licence plates, while commercial and taxi vehicles have **orange** plates.
NOTE: Orange plates can also be seen in Ecuador. Brazilian commercial plates are red, but can look similar in some lighting.
text_zh: 一般車輛使用**白色**車牌，而商業車輛和計程車使用**橘色**車牌。
注意：厄瓜多也能看到橘色車牌。巴西的商業車牌是紅色的，但在某些光線下看起來會很相似。

text: **Slots** can often be seen at the top of signposts.
text_zh: 標誌桿的頂部經常可以看到**缺口**。

text: Chile uses chevrons with a **yellow base **and **black arrows**.
NOTE: Argentina uses white with red arrows.
text_zh: 智利使用的轉彎標誌具有**黃色底**和**黑色箭頭**。
注意：阿根廷使用的是白色配紅色箭頭。

text: Chilean bollards are similar to **Spanish style** bollards, with a white reflector at the front and a yellow-orange reflector at the back. They are not super common.
text_zh: 智利的路樁類似於**西班牙風格**的路樁，正面有白色反光片，背面有黃橘色反光片。它們不是很常見。

text: While regular bollards are somewhat rare in Chile, you may sometimes find this **orange**, temporary bollard, with **two white stripes** at the top.
text_zh: 雖然一般路樁在智利不太常見，但有時你會發現這種頂部有**兩條白條紋**的**橘色**臨時路樁。

text: Bridges in Chile often have **red painted** fence posts.
text_zh: 智利的橋樑通常有**漆成紅色**的護欄柱。

text: Shown here is a **Köppen climate map** of Chile.
Chile is a long and narrow country that spans more than 4,000 kilometres from north to south, meaning that its climate varies significantly due to latitude.

The northern parts of the country, which lie in the tropical zone, are dry and arid, leading to a mild desert climate. In the centre, around the capital, the climate becomes less arid, leading to a temperate mediterranean climate. In the southernmost regions of Chile, which lie in the subantarctic zone, the climate is cold and wet, leading to a cool oceanic climate.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 此處顯示的是智利的**柯本氣候分類圖**（Köppen climate map）。
智利是一個狹長的國家，南北跨度超過 4,000 公里，這意味著其氣候會因緯度而有顯著差異。
該國北部位於熱帶地區，乾燥而乾旱，形成溫和的沙漠氣候。在中部首都周邊，氣候較不乾旱，形成溫和的地中海型氣候。在智利最南端的次南極帶地區，氣候寒冷潮濕，形成涼爽的海洋性氣候。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Chile uses a memorable regional road naming system, where the first letter increases between [A](https://goo.gl/maps/5sCeUaH9QXJVz6vt9) and [Y](https://goo.gl/maps/gD4ACFHPsD4bqpC37) from **north to south**. For more information on specific regions, see [here](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/chile?pli=1).
text_zh: 智利採用了一套令人印象深刻的區域道路命名系統，其中首字母從**北到南**在 [A](https://goo.gl/maps/5sCeUaH9QXJVz6vt9) 到 [Y](https://goo.gl/maps/gD4ACFHPsD4bqpC37) 之間遞增。有關特定地區的更多資訊，請參見[此處](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/chile?pli=1)。

text: Chilean phone codes will sometimes have a **two digit** area code in front, followed by seven digits. The patterns of the codes are easily memorable. Most of the central states also have different area codes for specific provinces, which can help you make accurate guesses.
text_zh: 智利電話號碼前方有時會有**兩位數**的區碼，後接七位數字。這些號碼的模式很容易記住。多數中部省份對特定省份也有不同的區碼，這有助於你做出準確的猜測。

text: The Atacama is an extremely arid desert covering the northern third of Chile. Some parts of it experience the lowest rainfall on the planet. As a result, many locations in this desert are almost completely devoid of any vegetation: you will often just see sand and bare rock without any plants in sight anywhere.
NOTE: The Atacama Desert also covers parts of southern Peru, western Bolivia and northwestern Argentina.
text_zh: 阿塔卡馬（Atacama）是極度乾旱的沙漠，涵蓋智利北部三分之一的土地。其中某些地區經歷了地球上最低的降雨量。因此，這座沙漠中的許多地方幾乎完全沒有任何植被：你經常只會看到沙子和裸露的岩石，放眼望去看不到任何植物。
注意：阿塔卡馬沙漠也涵蓋秘魯南部、玻利維亞西部和阿根廷西北部的一部分。

text: The region of Arica y Parinacota can be recognized by the **smooth, sandy** mountains that may look **slightly eroded**, or have [bulbous formations](https://goo.gl/maps/SRJ52GEYhEnuRU9G6). Valleys are also common, which are rarely seen in other parts of Chile.
text_zh: 阿里卡和帕里納科塔大區可以透過**平坦、沙質**的山脈來辨認，這些山脈看起來可能**有些侵蝕**，或有 [球狀地形](https://goo.gl/maps/SRJ52GEYhEnuRU9G6)。山谷也很常見，這在智利其他地區很少見。

text: These **rocky, uneven** mountains are most commonly seen in Atacama and northern Coquimbo.
text_zh: 這些**岩石質、不平坦**的山脈最常在阿塔卡馬和科金博北部看到。

text: This **brownish red soil** can sometimes be seen in Atacama region.
NOTE: This is most reliable in Generation 3. This soil can be seen in other regions in Generation 4.
text_zh: 這種**紅褐色土壤**有時可以在阿塔卡馬大區看到。
注意：這在第 3 代相機中最為準確。這種土壤在第 4 代相機的其他地區也能看到。

text: **Eucalyptus plantations** combined with a somewhat dry climate are a good indicator that you are in southwestern Valparaíso.
text_zh: **尤加利樹林**結合有點乾燥的氣候，是身處瓦爾帕萊索西南部的良好指標。

text: The region around Santiago can be recognized by its semi-arid climate, having **dry hills** and scattered vegetation.
text_zh: 聖地牙哥周邊地區可以透過其半乾旱氣候來辨認，擁有**乾燥山丘**和零星的植被。

text: Compared to the area around Santiago, the Maule region has a similar look. However, it has a **Mediterranean** climate, and is generally greener. **Vineyards** are also commonly seen in this region.
text_zh: 與聖地牙哥周邊地區相比，馬烏萊地區有著相似的外觀。然而，它具有**地中海**氣候，且通常更綠。**葡萄園**在這個地區也很常見。

text: Concepcion pines, scientifically named Pinus radiata, can be recognized by their **puffy** needles. They are most commonly found in **Bio Bio**, where the city of Concepcion is located, and less commonly in Ñuble and Araucania.
text_zh: 康塞普西翁松（學名為 Pinus radiata）可以透過它們**蓬鬆**的針葉來辨識。它們最常見於康塞普西翁所在的 **Bio Bio**，在紐布萊和阿勞卡尼亞則較少見。

text: **Narrow roads** with trees on both sides can commonly be seen in the regions of Bio Bio and Araucania.
text_zh: 兩側有樹木的**狹窄道路**常見於 Bio Bio 和阿勞卡尼亞大區。

text: **Monkey puzzles**, scientifically named Araucaria araucana, are found in far eastern Araucania.
NOTE: Monkey puzzles can also be found on the other side of the Argentinian border.
text_zh: **智利南洋杉**，學名為 Araucaria araucana，分佈在阿勞卡尼亞的最東部。
注意：智利南洋杉也可以在阿根廷邊境的另一側找到。

text: A **rolling, agricultural** landscape, comparable to New Zealand, can be seen on Isla Grande de Chiloé.
NOTE: Similar looking landscapes exist in some other parts of the country, but usually more level.
text_zh: 具有**起伏、農業**風貌、可媲美紐西蘭的景觀，可以在奇洛埃大島上看到。
注意：該國其他一些地區也存在類似外觀的景觀，但通常更平坦。

text: **Chilean rhubarb** can commonly be found on Isla Grande, and on the mainland east of it. Chilean rhubarb can be recognized by its large, cabbage-like appearance.
text_zh: **燈籠草（Chilean rhubarb）**常見於奇洛埃大島以及其東側的本土陸地上。燈籠草可以透過其巨大、像高麗菜的外觀來辨認。

text: **Lush green valleys**, with rocky mountains and often overcast coverage, can be seen in southern Los Lagos and northern Aysén.
text_zh: **蔥鬱的綠色山谷**，伴隨岩石山脈以及經常陰天的街景覆蓋，可以在洛斯拉戈斯南部和艾森北部看到。

text: Southern Aysén can be recognised by **autumn coverage**, having orange and red coloured vegetation. Keep in mind that not all coverage in this region will have fall colours.
text_zh: 艾森南部可以透過**秋季街景覆蓋**來辨認，擁有橘色和紅色的植被。請記住，並非此地區的所有街景覆蓋都有秋季色彩。

text: Roadlines with **dotted paint** are common in Los Ríos and Aysén.
text_zh: 帶有**虛線漆**的路面標線常見於洛斯里奧斯和艾森。

text: The A-31 can be recognised by its **high altitude**, with a **steep drop** into a valley to the north. The road also has Gen 3 sunset coverage.
text_zh: A-31 公路可以透過其**高海拔**來辨認，向北望去有**陡峭下坡**通往山谷。該路段也有第 3 代相機的日落街景覆蓋。

text: Generation 4 sunset coverage can be seen on Ruta 21 from Calama to San Francisco de Chiu Chiu. In the west near Calama, the sun has just started to set, causing a giant white dome in the sky. In the east, the sky has a warm **gradient**, and the tops of the volcanoes are seen glowing pink.
text_zh: 第 4 代相機的日落街景覆蓋可以在從卡拉馬到聖弗朗西斯科德丘丘的 21 號公路（Ruta 21）上看到。在靠近卡拉馬的西部，太陽剛剛開始下山，在天空中形成一個巨大的白色圓頂。在東部，天空有著溫暖的**漸層**，火山的頂部呈現發光的粉紅色。

text: More Generation 4 Sunset coverage can be seen on B-710 and Ruta 5.
On the B-710, a **slight ridge** can be seen to the west, while Ruta 5 is more open. Make sure to use the road angle or other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 更多第 4 代相機的日落街景覆蓋可以在 B-710 和 5 號公路（Ruta 5）上看到。
在 B-710 上，向西可以看到**輕微的山脊**，而 5 號公路則更為開闊。在盲猜前，務必利用道路角度或其他線索。

text: Ruta 1 is a coastal road that is easily recognized by the **wall of mountains** to the east, and the **Pacific Ocean** to the west. This image shows the various weather conditions faced on the road to help you make closer guesses.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 1 號公路（Ruta 1）是一條沿海公路，其東側的**山壁**以及西側的**太平洋**使其非常容易辨認。這張圖片展示了該道路上遇到的各種天氣狀況，幫助你做出更精確的猜測。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Part of Ruta 41 is located in a valley, with **snowy** mountains seen in the distance. Many trees and vineyards can commonly be seen toward the west. Triple yellow lines can also be seen from [this point](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5).
text_zh: 41 號公路（Ruta 41）的一部分位於山谷中，遠處可以看到**積雪的**山脈。向西常可見到許多樹木和葡萄園。從 [這個點](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5) 還可以看到三黃線。

text: These **purple flowers**, named Large-leaved Lupines, can commonly be found along Ruta 240.
text_zh: 這些名為大葉羽扇豆的**紫色花朵**，常沿著 240 號公路（Ruta 240）被發現。

text: **All yellow lines** on a **concrete road** are a good indicator that you are on a paved road in the Magallanes region, in the very south of Chile. The landscape tends to be barren, grassy, and treeless.
NOTE: Ruta 9 only appears in Generation 3, whereas the other roads only appear in Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **全黃線**加上**水泥路**是你在智利最南端的麥哲倫地區行駛於鋪裝道路上的好指標。景觀往往是貧瘠、長滿草且無樹木的。
注意：9 號公路（Ruta 9）只出現在第 3 代相機中，而其他道路只出現在第 4 代街景覆蓋中。

text: A distinct landscape consisting of a line of snow-capped mountains with two other isolated, symmetrical **snow-capped volcanoes** are seen in Lauca National Park. Most of the roads are newly paved and have a smooth, dark look.
text_zh: 勞卡國家公園（Lauca National Park）中可以看到一條獨特的景觀，由一排覆雪的山脈以及另外兩座孤立、對稱的**覆雪火山**組成。大部分道路都是新鋪設的，具有平坦、深色的外觀。

text: The northern section of Pampa del Tamarugal National Reserve can be recognized by the **Tamarugo trees** lining the road. The road itself is mediocre quality, and in a consistent north-west direction.
text_zh: 帕馬德爾塔馬魯加爾國家保護區（Pampa del Tamarugal National Reserve）的北部可以透過路邊排列的**塔馬魯戈樹**來辨認。道路本身的品質一般，且方向一致朝西北方。

text: Alto Loa National Reserve can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to snow-capped **volcanoes**. The road running through the reserve is paved.
text_zh: 阿爾托洛阿國家保護區（Alto Loa National Reserve）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往**火山**的**鹽灘**。貫穿保護區的道路是鋪裝道路。

text: **Smooth** mountains with a **reddish** tint are seen in Los Flamencos National Reserve. Salt pans are also a common sight. The reserve uses triple yellow lines, with [short dashes](https://goo.gl/maps/Z18RdxWXXB2c1FAr7) in the west.
text_zh: 洛斯弗拉門戈斯國家保護區（Los Flamencos National Reserve）內可以看到帶有**微紅**色調的**平坦**山脈。鹽灘也是常見的景象。該保護區使用三黃線，西部則有 [短短的虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/Z18RdxWXXB2c1FAr7)。

text: In the west, Nevado Tres Cruces National Park can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to a line of mountains. The sand has a **reddish **tint.
In the east, the Google Car drives up a mountain pass with views of lightly snow-capped volcanoes and **snow **on the side of the road. The roads in the National Park are paved.
text_zh: 在西部，內瓦多特雷斯克魯塞斯國家公園（Nevado Tres Cruces National Park）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往一排山脈的**鹽灘**。沙子帶有**紅色**調。
在東部，Google 車行駛在一個山隘上，可以看到微帶積雪的火山以及路邊的**雪**。國家公園內的道路都是鋪裝道路。

text: Llanos de Challe National Park can be recognized by the **brown** coloured dirt on the roadside, patches of light sand, **juniper** plants, and dark coloured mountains. The sky is overcast in most of the coverage.
NOTE: [Pan de Azúcar National Park](https://goo.gl/maps/QyUDrkEedZ29m21G8) looks similar, however has less vegetation.
text_zh: 亞諾斯德查爾雷國家公園（Llanos de Challe National Park）可以透過路邊**褐色**的泥土、零星的淺色沙地、**杜松**植物以及深色的山脈來辨認。大部分街景覆蓋的天空都是陰天。
注意：[潘德阿蘇卡國家公園](https://goo.gl/maps/QyUDrkEedZ29m21G8) 看起來類似，但植被較少。

text: A **vast**, mostly treeless landscape combined with triple yellow lines are seen in Alto Bio Bio National Reserve. While the reserve may look dry, there is a distinct cold and **high altitude** feel. [Monkey puzzles](https://goo.gl/maps/j5q5VVZamhkFDLSQ6) are also seen toward the east.
NOTE: Ruta 181 leading up to the reserve also has triple yellow lines, however, is less vast with more vegetation.
text_zh: 阿爾托比奧比奧國家保護區（Alto Bio Bio National Reserve）中可以看到**廣闊**、幾乎沒有樹木的景觀結合三黃線。雖然保護區看起來可能很乾燥，但有一種明顯寒冷和**高海拔**的感覺。向東也可以看到 [智利南洋杉](https://goo.gl/maps/j5q5VVZamhkFDLSQ6)。
注意：通往該保護區的 181 號公路（Ruta 181）也有三黃線，然而範圍較不廣闊且植被較多。

text: Puyehue National Park can be recognized by the dense vegetation surrounding the road. The pavement itself has triple yellow lines, and **tar snakes** are frequently seen. In the east, many [**dead trees**](https://goo.gl/maps/vvvheTYM3U7XohwK9) can be seen with a lack of leaves.
text_zh: 普耶胡埃國家公園（Puyehue National Park）可以透過環繞道路的茂密植被來辨認。路面本身有三黃線，並且經常可以看到**補路瀝青（tar snakes）**。在東部，可以看到許多缺少樹葉的 [**枯樹**](https://goo.gl/maps/vvvheTYM3U7XohwK9)。

text: A **slight, sandy** ridge with a **gradual** incline can be seen in Arica.
text_zh: 在阿里卡可以看到**輕微、沙質**的山脊，帶有**漸進的**坡度。

text: A **larger, towering** ridge can be seen in Iquique.
text_zh: 在伊基克可以看到**更大、高聳的**山脊。

text: A **rockier**, and more **uneven** ridge can be seen in Antofagasta.
text_zh: 在安托法加斯塔可以看到更**岩石質**且更**不平坦**的山脊。

text: San Pedro de Atacama can be recognized by its **clay brick** walls, commonly with triangles at the top.
text_zh: 聖佩德羅德阿塔卡馬可以透過其**土磚**牆來辨認，通常頂部有三角形。

text: **Orange street signs** can be seen at almost every intersection in the city of Lanco, and occasionally in the nearby town of Malalhue.
text_zh: **橘色街道標誌**幾乎可以在蘭科市的每個路口看到，在附近的馬拉爾韋鎮則偶爾可見。

text: Villa O’Higgins can be recognized by the large **mountains** located immediately to the east. To the west, [snow-capped mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99) are seen in the distance. Street signs, fences and many other structures throughout the village are made of orange-stained wood.
text_zh: 維拉奧伊金斯（Villa O’Higgins）可以透過位於正東方的大型**山脈**來辨認。向西望去，遠處可以看到 [覆雪山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99)。村莊各處的街道標誌、柵欄和許多其他結構都是由染成橘色的木頭製成的。

text: Orange lamps can most often be seen in Calama and Chañaral, and rarely in Antofagasta.
NOTE: Orange lamps can rarely be found in other smaller cities. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 橘色燈具最常出現在加拉馬 (Calama) 與查納拉爾 (Chañaral)，在安托法加斯塔 (Antofagasta) 則很罕見。
註：橘色燈具極少數也會出現在其他較小的城市。在進行猜測前，請務必尋找其他線索。

text: Lamps that look like **green domes** can be seen in Copiapo.
text_zh: 形狀像**綠色圓頂**的燈具可以在科皮亞波 (Copiapo) 看到。

text: Lamps in Santiago very commonly have **photocells**. You will rarely find them in other cities such as Valparaiso, Osorno and Loncoche.
text_zh: 聖地牙哥的燈具非常常見到有**光敏電阻**。你在其他城市如瓦爾帕萊索 (Valparaiso)、奧索爾諾 (Osorno) 與隆科切 (Loncoche) 則很少見到。

text: Grey lamps with a thin, flat top and a **rounded underside** can be found in Talca.
text_zh: 帶有薄而平坦頂部以及**圓形底部**的灰色燈具可以在塔爾卡 (Talca) 找到。

text: **Blue rectangular** lamps with a **yellow stripe** can be found in Concepción.
text_zh: 帶有**黃色條紋**的**藍色長方形**燈具可以在康 Concepción 找到。

text: This lamp, with a **silver top** and **grey bottom**, can be found in Puerto Montt and Temuco.
text_zh: 這種擁有**銀色頂部**與**灰色底部**的燈具，可以在蒙特港 (Puerto Montt) 與特木科 (Temuco) 找到。

text: Poles in Arica feature **white** paint with a black number, while the other cities in the Atacama Desert feature poles with [**yellow**](https://goo.gl/maps/xfQm8JHGpC6VCDR47) paint. Keep in mind the paint may have faded, making it look white.
text_zh: 阿里卡 (Arica) 的電線桿特色是漆成**白色**並帶有黑色數字，而阿他加馬沙漠的其他城市則是漆成[**黃色**](https://goo.gl/maps/xfQm8JHGpC6VCDR47)的電線桿。請記住，漆料可能會褪色而看起來像白色。

text: **Round** poles with black paint can be seen in the town of El Salvador.
text_zh: 漆成黑色的**圓形**電線桿可以在薩爾瓦多鎮 (El Salvador) 看到。

text: The Google car can be seen towing a **white and silver trailer** with the word ‘Outback’ south of the Chilean National Zoo in Santiago.
text_zh: Google 車在聖地牙哥的智利國家動物園以南，拖著一台帶有「Outback」字樣的**白銀相間拖車**。

text: A **grey** Toyota Hilux, with various gear loaded and a **snorkel** on the front right, can be seen from around Baños Morales to [this point](https://goo.gl/maps/SWHeb1yv3ppVSbBTA), where the trekker continues the journey on foot.
text_zh: 一台載有各種裝備且右前側裝有**呼吸管**的**灰色** Toyota Hilux，可以從巴尼奧斯莫拉萊斯 (Baños Morales) 一帶一直看到[這個點](https://goo.gl/maps/SWHeb1yv3ppVSbBTA)，在那裡徒步拍攝改以步行繼續旅程。

text: Conguillio National Park can be recognized by this **white truck** with visible side mirrors and an antenna on the front right.
text_zh: 孔吉利奧國家公園 (Conguillio National Park) 可以透過這台看得見車側後視鏡與右前側天線的**白色卡車**來識別。

text: Puerto Williams, the southernmost town covered by street view, can be recognized by this **white** pickup truck with visible side mirrors.
NOTE: The Puerto Williams coverage is located fairly far away from the normal car coverage in Chile. The nearest normal car coverage is in Fuerte Bulnes, near Punta Arenas.
text_zh: 被街景覆蓋的最南端城鎮威廉斯港 (Puerto Williams)，可以透過這台看得見車側後視鏡的**白色**皮卡車來識別。
註：威廉斯港的街景覆蓋距離智利正常的汽車覆蓋範圍相當遠。最近的正常汽車覆蓋位於蓬塔阿雷納斯附近的富爾內斯堡 (Fuerte Bulnes)。

text: The Atacama Large Millimetre Array can be recognized by the many radio telescopes in a barren, snowy environment.
text_zh: 阿他加馬大型毫米波陣列望遠鏡可以透過荒涼、有雪的環境中的許多電波望遠鏡來識別。

text: ALMA OSF can be recognized by the large radio telescopes and rural facilities.
text_zh: ALMA OSF 可以透過大型電波望遠鏡與鄉村設施來識別。

text: This **horse trekker** can be seen to the northeast of San Felipe.
NOTE: A similar trekker can be found on the other side of the border in Argentina.
text_zh: 這個**騎馬徒步拍攝**可以在聖費利佩 (San Felipe) 東北方看到。
註：相似的徒步拍攝可以在國界另一側的阿根廷找到。

text: The Torres del Paine area can be recognized by the **sharp peaked** mountains, and the trekker walking on a **glacier** along with other people in orange helmets.
text_zh: 百內國家公園地區可以透過**尖峭峰頂**的山脈，以及在**冰川**上行走、身穿橘色頭盔的其他人來識別。
